title: Use timestamp instructions in Seedance 2.5 to place specific story beats across…
content: Use timestamp instructions in Seedance 2.5 to place specific story beats across the sequence (e.g., 00:00 establish the world, 00:03 introduce movement, 00:06 reveal new information, 00:09 land the story beat) instead of relying only on visual adjectives.
tips: Use timestamp instructions in Seedance 2.5 to place specific story beats across the sequence (e.g., 00:00 establish the world, 00:03 introduce movement, 00:06 reveal new information, 00:09 land the story beat) instead of relying only on visual adjectives.

es.content: Usa instrucciones de timestamp en Seedance 2.5 para colocar beats narrativos específicos a lo largo de la secuencia (por ejemplo, 00:00 establecer el mundo, 00:03 introducir movimiento, 00:06 revelar nueva información, 00:09 cerrar el beat narrativo) en lugar de depender solo de adjetivos visuales.

fr.content: Utilisez les instructions de timestamp dans Seedance 2.5 pour placer des moments narratifs précis tout au long de la séquence (par exemple, 00:00 établir le monde, 00:03 introduire le mouvement, 00:06 révéler une nouvelle information, 00:09 conclure le moment narratif) au lieu de vous appuyer uniquement sur des adjectifs visuels.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5では、timestampの指示を使って、シーケンス全体にわたって特定のストーリービートを配置します（例：00:00 で世界観を確立し、00:03 で動きを導入し、00:06 で新しい情報を明かし、00:09 でストーリービートを着地させる）— 視覚的な形容詞だけに頼らないようにします。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5에서 timestamp 지시어를 사용해 시퀀스 전반에 걸쳐 특정 스토리 비트를 배치하세요(예: 00:00 세계관 설정, 00:03 움직임 도입, 00:06 새로운 정보 공개, 00:09 스토리 비트 마무리). 시각적 형용사에만 의존하지 마세요.

pt.content: Use instruções de timestamp no Seedance 2.5 para posicionar beats específicos da história ao longo da sequência (por exemplo, 00:00 estabelecer o mundo, 00:03 introduzir movimento, 00:06 revelar novas informações, 00:09 fechar o beat da história) em vez de depender apenas de adjetivos visuais.

zh.content: 在 Seedance 2.5 中使用时间戳指令，将特定的故事节奏分布到整个序列中（例如，00:00 建立世界观，00:03 引入动作，00:06 揭示新信息，00:09 落下故事节拍），而不是只依赖视觉形容词。
